answer_1.quote: Parallel Data Curation (PDC) aims at extracting high-quality parallel sentence pairs from noisy webmined corpora... we train NMT models (Section 4.4) using the top-ranked 100k sentence pairs... and report the ChrF++ scores.

answer_2.quote: We use ChrF++ to report NMT results.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to quantify the noise before and after applying the heuristics... Each sentence pair is annotated by three translators... using the taxonomy discussed in Section 3.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators categorized parallel sentences using a taxonomy including CC (perfect translation), CN (near perfect), CB (low-quality), CCN (high-overlapping non-translatable text), CS (short sentence), X (wrong translation), UN (untranslated), WL (wrong language), NL (not a language)
